nameOverride.title: Chart name override
nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in resource names and labels.

fullnameOverride.title: Full name override
fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the generated name of the Deployment, Service, ServiceAccount and RBAC pair. The Service name is part of the gRPC cluster address in the EnvoyFilter, so overriding it rewrites that address too.

mode.title: Components to run
mode.description: all runs the controller and the rate limit service in one Deployment. controller and rls exist for a future split; only all is exercised today.

leaderElect.title: Leader election
leaderElect.description: Gates status writes only. The rate limit endpoint and its rule store run on every replica.

port.title: gRPC port
port.description: Port of the Envoy rate limit service. 8081 is reserved for the health probes.

timeout.title: Check timeout
timeout.description: Envoy-side timeout for a rate limit check, as a protobuf duration: seconds with an optional fraction, e.g. 0.05s. Go-style values such as 50ms are rejected by Envoy.

failClosed.title: Fail closed
failClosed.description: true rejects traffic when the rate limit service is unreachable (failure_mode_deny). Keep false while the service is an allow-all stub.

rateLimitedStatus.title: Refusal status
rateLimitedStatus.description: Status the client sees on a refused request. Envoy ignores values below 400.

grpcAsResourceExhausted.title: gRPC refusal code
grpcAsResourceExhausted.description: true maps a refusal to RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for gRPC callers behind the gateway — the code their clients back off and retry on — instead of UNAVAILABLE.

xRateLimitHeaders.title: x-ratelimit response headers
xRateLimitHeaders.description: The service supplies the x-ratelimit-* and retry-after headers itself. DRAFT_VERSION_03 additionally lets Envoy render X-RateLimit-* from per-descriptor statuses, which the service does not populate, so OFF is the default.

runtime.title: Filter switches
runtime.description: Share of requests the filter checks (enabledPercent) and enforces on (enforcedPercent). Emergency controls independent of behavior: Shadow in the rules; rendered as Envoy runtime fractions, so a runtime override flips them without a redeploy.

redis.title: Counter store
redis.description: Redis holds the counters. An empty address list falls back to an in-process store, which counts per replica and is therefore correct at one replica only: with N replicas a limit of 100 admits 100*N.

addresses.title: Redis addresses
addresses.description: Comma-separated host:port list. One entry is a standalone server, several are a cluster; with masterName set they are Sentinel addresses. Empty selects the in-process store.

db.title: Database index
db.description: Ignored by Redis Cluster, which has one database.

username.title: Username
username.description: Leave empty for a server without ACL users.

masterName.title: Sentinel master name
masterName.description: Set to select Sentinel; the addresses are then the sentinels.

existingSecret.title: Password secret
existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret holding the password. The password is read from a Secret rather than from values, because values end up in the release and the release is readable by anyone with get on Secrets in the namespace.

nearLimitRatio.description: Share of a rule's limit consumed before an admission counts as near-limit; a ratio in (0, 1).

MONITORING_ENABLED.title: The MONITORING_ENABLED schema
MONITORING_ENABLED.description: Set to true to import dashboards to Grafana and configure integration with Prometheus. Requires Platform System Monitor CRDs to be deployed to target k8s/openshift cluster

ISTIO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_NAME.title: Public gateway name
ISTIO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_NAME.description: Name of the public Istio gateway. Shared deployment parameter: must equal ISTIO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_NAME in qubership-core-mesh-config, which creates the Gateway.

ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME.title: Private gateway name
ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME.description: Name of the private Istio gateway. Shared deployment parameter: must equal ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME in qubership-core-mesh-config, which creates the Gateway.

gateways.title: Rate limited gateways
gateways.description: One EnvoyFilter is rendered per enabled gateway. The gateway names come from the ISTIO_*_GATEWAY_NAME parameters, not from here.

enabled.description: Render an EnvoyFilter for this gateway.

domain.title: Rate limit domain
domain.description: Binding key between this gateway and a RateLimitPolicy. Must equal spec.domain of the policy that carries the gateway's rules; a mismatch is silent apart from an unknown-rate-limit-domain line in the service log. The pattern is the CRD's spec.domain pattern, so a value the policy side cannot ever carry is refused here too.

namespace.title: Gateway namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway. The EnvoyFilter is created there, because Istio resolves targetRefs within the EnvoyFilter's own namespace. Defaults to the release namespace, which is where qubership-core-mesh-config puts the gateways; set it only if they live elsewhere.

timeout.title: Check timeout override
timeout.description: Overrides rls.timeout for this gateway. Same format: a protobuf duration such as 0.05s.

failClosed.title: Fail closed override
failClosed.description: Overrides rls.failClosed for this gateway. An explicit false wins over a true default.

rateLimitedStatus.title: Refusal status override
rateLimitedStatus.description: Overrides rls.rateLimitedStatus for this gateway. Envoy ignores values below 400.

enabled.description: Render an EnvoyFilter for this gateway.

domain.title: Rate limit domain
domain.description: Binding key between this gateway and a RateLimitPolicy. Must equal spec.domain of the policy that carries the gateway's rules; a mismatch is silent apart from an unknown-rate-limit-domain line in the service log. The pattern is the CRD's spec.domain pattern, so a value the policy side cannot ever carry is refused here too.

namespace.title: Gateway namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway. The EnvoyFilter is created there, because Istio resolves targetRefs within the EnvoyFilter's own namespace. Defaults to the release namespace, which is where qubership-core-mesh-config puts the gateways; set it only if they live elsewhere.

timeout.title: Check timeout override
timeout.description: Overrides rls.timeout for this gateway. Same format: a protobuf duration such as 0.05s.

failClosed.title: Fail closed override
failClosed.description: Overrides rls.failClosed for this gateway. An explicit false wins over a true default.

rateLimitedStatus.title: Refusal status override
rateLimitedStatus.description: Overrides rls.rateLimitedStatus for this gateway. Envoy ignores values below 400.

name.description: Defaults to the chart's fullname when empty.

MEMORY_REQUEST.title: The MEMORY_REQUEST schema
MEMORY_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the container will use to start
